newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICA WIN TOSS, AUSTRALIA BAT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICA WIN TOSS, AUSTRALIA BAT.

text.p: South Africa won the toss and put Australia in to bat on the first day of the third and final cricket test on Friday:
South Africa - Adam Bacher, Gary Kirsten, Brian McMillan, Daryll Cullinan, Hansie Cronje (captain), Jacques Kallis, Dave Richardson, Lance Klusener, Pat Symcox, Brett Schultz, Allan Donald.
Australia - Mark Taylor (captain), Matthew Hayden, Matthew Elliott, Mark Waugh, Steve Waugh, Greg Blewett, Michael Bevan, Ian Healy, Shane Warne, Jason Gillespie, Glenn McGrath.
Australia have an unbeatable 2-0 lead in the series.
